lokele: Lona eloayalaka ko nda baakoelo, eloaokak’iso, la elwɛnɛk’iso la baiso basu, eloatichakak’iso, la eloamatakak’iso la besamba yasu, loko loasɔ loa Lioi lia Liwawi,
english: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

lokele: (liwawi lina liɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ to la twɛnɛkɛ liao la tosokambesa ino la tosonangoel’ino loasɔ loa Liwawi lina lia layalaya eliayalaka ko ende Sango la eliɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ end’iso).
english: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);

lokele: Lona elwɛnɛkɛ nd’iso la eloaokak’iso, tosonangoela imɔ ko ino, mbo ino imɔ osukaneke lasu lisaɔ; la lisukani-li liasu lile to amamwito la Sango la amamwito la Wana wande ako Yesu Masiya.
english: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ. 1:3

lokele: Tososɔnɛl’ino njasɔ-bi mbo bootaota wasu bɔɔlwɛkɛ.
english: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

lokele: Wɛndi ebokak’iso ende Ngɛnɛ la wao ebotonangoel’iso ino wende mbo— Mungu ende Löwa la end’Inde angwɛnɛ lilima ango sinyo.
english: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

lokele: Eya toonga mbo tososukana lande l’ani tokoyali nda lilima, ongoma tosoonga ko lolanga la toti bato ba wewe;
english: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.

lokele: nde eya mbo tokɛndɛ nda löwa kwa ayali Inde nda löwa, ani tososukana boto la boto lisaɔ, la bakila ba Yesu Wana wande basotanekes’iso batwanelo batotina.
english: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

lokele: Eya toonga mbo toti la bobe, ani tosolimbakel’iso angɛnɛ la wewe bot’imɔ nda betema yasu;
english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

lokele: nde toaola batwanelo basu, Inde nd’ayali wolendelomo la ewa liengani mbo amɛsɛlɛk’iso batwanelo basu la atanekes’iso bitotina ebitiengane.
english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

lokele: Eya toonga mbo totikeleke batwanelo ani tosof’Inde lolanga la lioi liande lit’imɔ nda betema yasu.
english: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

lokele: E bana bami bakɛkɛ, isosɔnɛl’ino njasɔ-bi mbo otatwanelo; nde eya to mbo boto etwanelo, ani tole la Boongeli woongel’iso ende Sango, ako Yesu Masiya Oyengani,
english: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor 2:1 with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

lokele: la Inde nd’ale Likambi lioendol’iso loasɔ loa batwanelo basu, inga ko eoka eyasu kongo, kangä eoka ya eba wenda bototi.
english: And he is the atoning sacrifice 2:2 for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

lokele: Toluwi nde mbo tosolu wak’Inde ko ani asolites’iso bikela yande.
english: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

lokele: Oyatoonga mbo— Isoluw’Inde, ani atilitese bikela yande, inde ale ngo la lolanga la wewe bot’imɔ nda botema wande;
english: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

lokele: nde oyatolitesa lioi liande, wewe losamɔ loa Mungu losoengana chaa nda botema wande. Ko la loasɔ-lo tosoluwa mbo toyali nde tɔɔ end’Inde;
english: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

lokele: boto oyatoonga mbo asokɔkɔmɔ tɔɔ end’Inde, ambo aondu nde ndoyala la boyaeli ewayalaka lande.
english: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

lokele: Ino basamomu, itisɔnɛl’ino ekela eyai, kangä ekela eyesoumwaka la eyaɔlɔk’ino ko nda liakoli; ekela eyesoumwa yende lioi elisokak’ino.
english: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

lokele: Nde isosɔnɛl’ino oko ekela eyai, la end’Inde la end’ino lisanga yende ngo wewe, mbo lilima lisowanjwa la löwa loa wewe losoana oko kwani.
english: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

lokele: Boto oyasoonga mbo ale nda löwa ani asoiyana la booto lande, akoyali ngo ko nda lilima ko kwani.
english: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

lokele: Boto oyasosama booto lande, asoanyema nda löwa la at’imɔ la litina liokwesaka basi likulia.
english: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

lokele: Nde boto oyasoiyana la booto lande akoyali kɔni nda lilima la akokɛndɛkɛndɛ nda lilima, aitoluwa olo atɔkɛ lande eoka lilima lisotufesa baiso bande.
english: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

lokele: Bana bakɛkɛ, isosɔnɛl’ino lokasa eoka batwanelo banu basomɛsɛlɔmɔ ko l’eoka ya lina liande.
english: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

lokele: Basango, isosɔnɛl’ino lokasa eoka oluwi nde Inde Oyayali ko nda liakoli. Tosenge, isosɔnɛl’ino lokasa eoka osokwesa la osolonga Ewa Bobe. Bana, isosɔnɛl’ino lokasa eoka osoluwa Sango.
english: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

lokele: Basango, isosɔnɛl’ino lokasa eoka oluwi nde Inde Oyayali ko nda liakoli. Tosenge, isosɔnɛl’ino lokasa eoka wende la bofoka finɛ, la lioi lia Mungu likoyali nda betema yanu la eoka osokwesa Ewa Bobe.
english: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

lokele: Osamëke wenda-bo, ango ko biengo ebile nda wenda-bo; eya mbo boto esama wenda-bo, ambo ati la losamɔ loa Mungu nda botema wande.
english: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

lokele: Eoka bitoti ebile nda wenda, biko yɛmɛ ya bindo, la yɛmɛ yolola ebitɔɛnɛ bato la baiso, la tofälä twa liwawi-li, yao-bi bitisekwe ende Sango kangä nda wenda-bo.
english: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

lokele: Wenda-bo bosowanjwa mbao la yɛmɛ ya wao imɔ, kongo ko inde oyatolitesa lisangi lia Mungu atotikala nde ko layalaya. Beimo ende bana ba Etanda ya Masiya
english: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

lokele: Bana’mi, mbile ya liko esoya to; kwa okak’ino mbo Bofekwani la Masiya atoya, ongoma kwani bafekwani ba Masiya basoyala; ko ongoma tosoluwa mbo mbile ya liko esoya.
english: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

lokele: Basekwak’end’iso nde batiayalaka ebasu, eoka eya to mbo beyalaka ebasu, ani basoumwaka lasu; nde basekwaka end’iso eoka ndwɛnɛsɛ fololo mbo batotina bati ebasu.
english: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

lokele: La ino nd’asowɛlɔmɔ ko loücho loa Ewa Botanu, limɔ ino batotina nd’aluwi ebile wewe;
english: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge. 2:20

lokele: isosɔnɛl’ino lokasa, inga eoka mbo otiluwe wewe, kangä mbo oluwi nde wao la mbo lolanga loti ango loa wewe.
english: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

lokele: ¿Ndai to nd’ayali ewa lolanga, sakolo ngo ko inde oyatoanganya mbo— Yesu ati Masiya? Oyatoanganya Sango la Wana, boto ona ende Bofekwani la Masiya;
english: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

lokele: angwɛnɛ boto oyatoanganya Wana, koyala la Sango. Nde oyatoaolela Wana, ale imɔ ko la Sango.
english: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also. 2:23

lokele: Nde ebisokak’ino ko nda liakoli, bitikaleke ngo ko lanu; eya to mbo yao ebiokak’ino nda liakoli betikala nda betema yanu, ani ono kotikala tɔɔ ende Wana la ende Sango imɔ.
english: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

lokele: La lisakä eliatikelak’Inde etikel’iso liende ngo ko mbo Liwawi lia layalaya.
english: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

lokele: Isosɔnɛl’ino njasɔ-bi loasɔ loa bato ebatoengoles’ino.
english: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

lokele: Nde loücho elosowɛlɛmɛ ino ko end’Inde, losotikala lanu, la bot’imɔ la boeno mbo boto ekesek’ino; kangä eloande loücho lotoekekes’ino njasɔ bitotina la loao loende wewe, loti lolanga. La kwani asoekesa loao oekes’ino, tikalaka ngo ko end’Inde.
english: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

lokele: Kwani, bana bakɛkɛ, yalakaka ngo ko end’Inde, litina mbo akɛnɛlɛk’Inde toyaleke ko la lotendela lolau, angowangatalel’Inde la sɔni nda loyo loande.
english: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

lokele: Eya to mbo boluwa mbo ende Wengani, luwaka imɔ ko mbo boto oyakakeleke ko eya liengani, ambo aotomu nde ko lande.
english: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo, aina losamɔ elosofaefa Sango efaef’iso mbo totangomoko bana ba Mungu; la twende ko ongoma! Litina elitiluweke eba wenda oluw’iso lile mbo batiluwek’Inde angɛnɛ.
english: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

lokele: Ino basamomu, kwanikwani tole bana ba Mungu, nde bɔfɔnɔ ebokayalek’iso, bokɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ kɔni; kongo ko toluwi nde mbo akɛnɛlɛk’Inde, tolayalaka nde ko bɔfɔnɔ wande, eoka tolɛnɛk’Inde ani ayal’inde.
english: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

lokele: Boto la boto oyale la iɛli-si eoka ya Masiya, atotanesa botema wande angɛnɛ, ani ayal’Inde angɛnɛ botanu.
english: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

lokele: Boto la boto oyatotwanelo, ongoma asotefola Bikela; litwanelo lile ngo ko litefoli lia Bikela.
english: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

lokele: La ino nd’aluwi mbo Masiya ɛnɛlɛkɛ nde mbo asokoleke batwanelo basu la mbo end’Inde angɛnɛ, angwɛnɛ litwanelo.
english: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

lokele: Oyatoyalana lande, boto ona angotwanelo; oyatotwanelo ambo atiɛnɛ Inde la atiluw’Inde.
english: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

lokele: Bana bami, omachëke mbo boto alimbek’ino. Oyakakeleke ko liengani, ambo ende boto wa liengani kwa ayali Masiya Ewa Liengani.
english: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

lokele: Oyatokelaka batwanelo ambo inde ale wa Satana eoka Satana asotwanekelo ko nda liakoli; Wana wa Mungu nd’ɛnɛlɛkɛ ko la litina-li liko ndosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ ebisokelaka Satana.
english: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

lokele: Boto oyaotomu nde la Mungu, aitokelaka batwanelo, eoka lokoto loa liwawi lia Mungu losotikala lande, limɔ aitokɔkɔlɔ ndokelaka batwanelo eoka asootomo ko la Mungu.
english: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

lokele: Ko la e-litina-li losoɛnɛlɛ fololo l’ebale bana ba Mungu, l’ebale bana ba Satana; boto oyaitokelaka liengani, ambo ona ati wana wa Mungu, la oyatisame etungani yande imɔ ko ongoma.
english: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

lokele: Wɛndi ebokak’ino ko nda liako, bole ngo ko mbo tosamaneke;
english: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

lokele: angoyala kwa ayalaka Kaina oyaaka wana w’Oyo Bobe la oyaolaka etungani yande. ¿Aokal’inde litina moni? Eoka bekeeli yande angɛnɛ yaaka bibe, la eya etungani yande yaaka ko eyengani. Losamɔ lole ndembe ya bana ba Mungu
english: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

lokele: Bitungani yami, omwalëke eya mbo eba wenda-bo beiyana lanu;
english: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

lokele: iso nd’aluwi mbo tososekwa nda liwa okakwa nda liwawi, eoka mbo tososama bitungani. Oyati la losamɔ, ambo akotikali nda liwa.
english: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

lokele: Boto oyasoiyana la etungani yande, ambo inde ale booli wa boto, la oluwi nde mbo booli wa boto ati la loiko loa layalaya lotikala nda botema wande.
english: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

lokele: Ko la litina-li, tosoluwa losamɔ, mbo Masiya amachaka liwawi liande ndowel’iso; ongoma lole loasu ndomacha liwawi liasu ndowela bitungani yasu.
english: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

lokele: ¿Nde boto eyala la biengo ya wenda-bo la inde kɔɛnɛ etungani yande la boeno la eliekelak’inde botema wa shota, ani losamɔ loa Mungu koyala nda botema wande la moni?
english: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

lokele: Bana bami, tosamaneke, nde inga ko la lioi, ango ko la bɔnɔkɔ kongo, kangä ko la bekeeli la wewe.
english: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

lokele: Ko la litina-li toluwi nde mbo twende bana ba wewe, la tosɔɔngɛsɛ betema yasu nda baiso bande,
english: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

lokele: ani betema yasu angɛnɛ bitof’iso se; eoka Mungu nd’alongeli betema yasu la aluwi nde bitotina.
english: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

lokele: Basamomu, eya mbo betema yasu bitif’iso se, ani tosoyala la lotendela lolau ende Mungu,
english: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

lokele: limɔ yeka eyekafelek’iso, totɔɔlɔ yao end’Inde eoka mbo tosolitesa bikela yande la tosokelaka ngo ko yao ebisɔɛnɛlɛ bolau nda baiso bande.
english: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

lokele: Eye yende ekela yande, mbo tolendeloko lina lia Wana wande, ako Yesu Masiya la mbo tosamaneke kwa atelak’Inde etel’iso ekela.
english: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

lokele: Boto oyatolitekesa bikela yande, ambo asoyalaka lande la Inde asoyalaka la boto ona; limɔ ko la loasɔ-lo toluwi mbo atoyalaka lasu, ko la Bolimo oyafak’Inde efaef’iso.
english: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

lokele: Basamomu, wimelëke balimo batoti, kɔtɔlɔkɔ bao oluweke kwa mbo basoyala ba Mungu; eoka batɔndɔli ba nanga wike basokakɛndɛlɛ wenda-bo.
english: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

lokele: Otolembeela Bolimo wa Mungu ko ano; bolimo oyatoaola mbo Yesu Masiya asoya nda bindo ya boto, ambo bolimo ona bole wa Mungu;
english: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

lokele: nde bolimo oyaitoaola Yesu, ambo bolimo ona boti wa Mungu, la wao wende wa Bofekwani la Masiya, ewokak’ino mbo botoya nde, la kwani bole oko nda wenda-bo.
english: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

lokele: Nde ino, bana bami, wende ba Mungu la osolongela iyo, eoka Inde oyale nda betema yanu, ale ofi wolonga inde oyale nda wenda.
english: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

lokele: Iyo bende ba wenda-bo, eokao batoonga ko yao ebisekwi nda wenda la wenda botokak’iyo.
english: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

lokele: Iso twende bana ba Mungu, Inde oyaluwi nde Mungu, Inde nd’atokak’iso. Ko la litina-li, tosoluwa bolimo wa wewe la bolimo wa bolimbakeli.
english: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

lokele: Basamomu, tosamaneke, eoka losamɔ lososekwa ende Mungu, la boto oyatoyalaka la losamɔ, aotomu nde la Mungu la aluwi nde Mungu.
english: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

lokele: Boto oyatiyaleke la losamɔ, atiluwe Mungu; eoka Mungu ende Losamɔ.
english: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

lokele: Losamɔ loa Mungu losɔɛnɛlɛ end’iso ko la loasɔ-lo, loko mbo Mungu atomaka Wana wande ɔmwito nda wenda-bo, litina mbo tɔɔlɛkɛ loiko ko lande.
english: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born 4:9 Son into the world that we might live through him.

lokele: Losamɔ loa wewe losɔɛnɛlɛ ko la loasɔ-lo, inga mbo iso nd’asamaka Inde, kangä mbo Inde nd’asamak’iso la mbo atomaka Wana wande mbo ayaleke Likambi lioendol’iso loasɔ loa batwanelo basu. Losamɔ loa wewe lotosokokola bɔwa
english: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice 4:10 for our sins.

lokele: Basamomu, eya mbo Mungu asosamak’iso ongoma, ani lole loasu ndosamakana imɔ.
english: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

lokele: Angwɛnɛ boto angɔmɔi nd’ɛnɛkɛ Mungu lise ango limɔi; eya mbo tosamakana, ani Mungu koyalaka lasu la losamɔ loande lotɔɔlwa nda betema yasu.
english: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

lokele: Ko ongoma, tosoluwa mbo tosoyalaka lande la Inde imɔ ko lasu eoka mbo asofaef’iso Bolimo wande.
english: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

lokele: La iso nd’asɔɛnɛ la tosoonga fololo mbo Sango atomaka Wana wande ako Bouwesi wa wenda-bo.
english: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

lokele: Boto oyakaaoleke mbo Yesu ende Wana wa Mungu, ambo Mungu angɛnɛ asoyalaka nda botema wande la inde asoyalaka ko ende Mungu.
english: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

lokele: La iso nd’aluwi la tosoimela losamɔ elososamaka Mungu esamak’iso. Mungu ale ngo ko Losamɔ la boto oyasoyalaka ngo nda losamɔ, ambo asoyalaka ngo ende Mungu la Mungu imɔ ko end’inde.
english: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

lokele: Nda loasɔ-lo losamɔ loasu losɔɔlwa mbo toyaleke la lotendela lolau nda lise lia liateli lia njasɔ eoka tosoyala kwa ayali imɔ ko Inde nda wenda-bo.
english: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

lokele: Nda losamɔ angwɛnɛ bɔwa, nde losamɔ elosɔɔlɔlɔ lososokola bɔwa fwa, eoka bɔwa bole ko loasɔ loa likuchaki la oyasoka bɔwa, akaɔlwi ndoka losamɔ.
english: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

lokele: Iso nd’asosamaka, eoka Inde nd’asamak’iso ko oso.
english: We love him, 4:19 because he first loved us.

lokele: Eya mbo boto eonga mbo— Isosama Mungu, ani asoiyana la etungani yande, ambo ale la lolanga; eoka inde oyatisame etungani yande oyasɔɛn’inde, ambo atikɔkɔlɛ ndosama Mungu oyatiɛnɛk’inde.
english: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

lokele: Limɔ tole la ekela-ye eyatak’Inde, eko mbo— Inde oyasosama Mungu, asameke imɔ ko etungani yande.
english: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

lokele: Boto oyasoimela mbo Yesu ende Masiya, ambo asootomo la Mungu la boto oyasosama Inde oyaot’inde, ambo asosama imɔ ko oyaotomu lande.
english: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

lokele: Ko la loasɔ-lo toluwi nde mbo tososama bana ba Mungu, ani tososamaka Mungu angɛnɛ la mbo tosolitesa bikela yande.
english: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

lokele: Eoka losamɔ losamaka Mungu lole ngo ko mbo toliteseke bikela yande; la bikela yande biti ango la bolito wotola.
english: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

lokele: Eoka ebisootomo la Mungu, yao nd’atolongela wenda-bo, la lilongeli elitolongela wenda-bo lile ngo ko liimeli liasu.
english: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

lokele: ¿Ndai asolongela wenda-bo, sakolo ngo ko inde oyasoimela mbo Yesu ende Wana wa Mungu?
english: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

lokele: Ende Inde oyayaka ko la balia la bakila, ako Yesu Masiya, atiayaka ko la balia kongo, kanga ko la balia la bakila imɔ;
english: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

lokele: la Bolimo ale bokambesi woluwes’iso, eoka Bolimo ale ngo ko wewe.
english: For there are three who testify: 5:7

lokele: Bakambesi boluwes’iso loasɔ-lo, bende basatɔ, bako Bolimo la balia la bakila, la yaasatɔ bende ko ɔmwito.
english: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

lokele: Tokulia inango sha bato, ambo esha Mungu koeta esha balomboki, eoka mbo akambesak’iso loasɔ loa Wana wande.
english: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

lokele: Inde oyasolendelo Wana wa Mungu ale ngo ko la inango nda botema wande angɛnɛ; nde oyatiimele Mungu, asof’Inde lolanga eoka atiimele inango esisonangola Mungu loasɔ loa Wana wande angɛnɛ.
english: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

lokele: La inango sina sile ngo ko mbo Mungu afak’iso loiko loa layalaya la loiko-lo lole ngo ko la Wana wande.
english: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

lokele: Oyasoyalaka la Wana, asoyala la loiko, la oyatiyale la Wana, ambo atiyaleke la loiko.
english: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.

lokele: Isosɔnɛl’ino njasɔ-bi, bako ino ebasolendelo lina lia Wana wa Mungu, mbo boluweke fololo mbo wende la loiko loa layalaya.
english: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

lokele: Limɔ twende la lotendela lolau loko mbo, tofel’Inde yeka ko la lisangi liande, Inde kookak’iso;
english: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

lokele: eya to mbo toluwa mbo atokak’iso nda yao eyetofelak’iso, ani tosoluwa mbo tosoyala la lofelo lona elofel’iso inde.
english: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

lokele: Eya mbo boto ɛnɛ etungani yande ani atokela litwanelo elitikwe nda liwa, afeleke Mungu oyatof’inde loiko loasɔ loa batwanelo ebatiengane la liwa. Batwanelo bamɔi batoiya nda liwa, itionge mbo asomboleke loasɔ loa bao.
english: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.

lokele: Njasɔ bibe bitotina bile ngo ko batwanelo, nde bimɔi biitoiya ko nda liwa.
english: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.

lokele: Toluwi nde mbo boto oyaotomu la Mungu, aitokelaka batwanelo, nde oyasootomo la Mungu, atotinganaka lande limɔ Ewa Bobe angomata ango inde.
english: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.

lokele: Toluwi nde mbo tole bana ba Mungu la wenda-bo bototina bosoundomo ko la Ewa Bobe.
english: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

lokele: Kongo ko toluwi imɔ mbo Wana wa Mungu asoya la asofaef’iso liluwani mbo toluweke Inde oyale wewe, la tokoyala lande oyale wewe, ako Wana wande Yesu Masiya. Inde ale ngo ko Mungu wa wewe la Ngɛnɛ wa loiko loa layalaya!
english: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

lokele: Bana bami, lambaka ino angɛnɛ, otalitesa bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu.
english: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
